title: Evidence Collection Log — draft 0.1.0

seq.description: Monotonic per-log sequence, allocated by the log writer (codex rollout form). In-band — makes coverage checking a pure density function.

tool.description: The authorized tool channel invoked (e.g. bank-statement.fetch).

selector.description: What was queried within the tool's domain.

caller.description: Who initiated the call (an S2 investigation step id).

result_ref.description: Where the fetched evidence lives (a sealed-store address).

$comment: Piece-7 spike: the query-trail log that makes sealed-evidence completeness declarations machine-checkable (夏 ruling round-1): a declaration 'queried bank statements' must have a matching entry here. Deliberately NOT the piece-4 event ledger — that book keeps business events (adoption/effect, eight rule families, replay); this log keeps evidence-collection calls (append-only density). Two atoms, two logs (word-sense collision resolved by separation). Provenance: 夏 adjudication §2 (query-trail field, machine-checkable).
